signal: score = 1.0·z(EPS surprise) + 0.5·z(momentum) + 1.0·z(cheap P/E) + 1.0·z(AI-supply thesis) + 0.5·z(EPS revisions) → long the top 30 eligible names

screen.desc: OPEN universe (all tradeable tokenized perps + new listings) → profitability-AGNOSTIC investability screen: analyst coverage ≥ 12 AND revenue ≥ $0.5B. Keeps unprofitable hypergrowth (CRWV/RKLB), drops speculative shells (ONDS/GME).

thesis_tilt.desc: picks-&-shovels tilt — +W·z(supplier role OR AI-supply sector). Captures the thesis systematically; conviction-weighted.

valuation_overlay.evidence: Passed robustness: helps in 100%% of 18 param configs (median +0.40) + 2/3 sub-periods; rich tilt -0.57 (sign-consistent). Off on HL (33%% of configs).

smart_money.note: 13F-HR, ~45-day lag; long-equity + puts only. # of tracked filers long the name, from the panel. Cross-check, not a selection input. Full books of 15 AI-frontier crossover funds are on the Smart Money tab.

ai_thesis: Own the AI hardware / supply chain (firms that RECEIVE AI capex as revenue); avoid the hyperscalers & enterprises that SPEND the capex (uncertain ROIC, FCF pressure). Validated by Coatue ('Market is rewarding the sellers of the shortage'): the SELLERS of products in shortage (semis/memory/optics — high pricing power, fixed cost base, BIG EPS REVISIONS) returned ~107% YTD vs the BUYERS (hyperscalers — high capex, returns over years, modest EPS revisions) at ~4%.

coatue_evidence.source: Coatue, 'Market is rewarding the sellers of the shortage' (2026)

ai_finding: OPEN universe (all tradeable perps, discovered from Binance) → investability screen → eps+mom+val + thesis tilt, diversified top-30. NO hand-curation: the early ~34-name backtest was a point-in-time DATA-coverage limit (AlphaVantage/EDGAR), not stock-picking. Full free-data coverage (yfinance eps = AV quality) + discovery let the same systematic process run on the complete universe — Sharpe ~3.1 vs ~2.7 (data-complete vs data-limited), auto-including SK Hynix/Samsung/Dell. The signal is an ordering tool, not a universe builder — indiscriminate breadth without the screen + tilt tanks it (1.6). EXTERNAL VALIDATION: Coatue's 'sellers of the shortage' (our suppliers) +107% YTD vs 'buyers' (our excluded spenders) +4%.
note: Single-name selection research on the validated signal. Valuation overlay & 13F are CONTEXT/validation, not live selection inputs. Research, not investment advice.
